project_summary: A content and growth strategy engagement covering social presence, posting cadence, and a 90-day content calendar.
outcome: A repeatable content system your team can run without you, plus the first 90 days of content planned and ready to execute.
approach_highlights: Audit of current channels and competitor positioning
A content pillar framework tailored to your audience
A 90-day calendar with topics, formats, and posting cadence
scope_fee_credit_note: credited in full toward the project if you move forward
detailed_scope: Week 1: Channel audit, competitor teardown (5 accounts), audience research summary
Week 2: Content pillar framework (4-6 pillars) with example topics per pillar
Week 3: 90-day calendar (topic, format, hook, posting day) delivered as a spreadsheet
Week 4: Handoff call + lightweight style guide (tone, do/don't examples)
timeline: 4 weeks from scope fee payment to final handoff call.
